# Can Michael Torres approve DR-9107? No.

He cannot approve it. The request also cannot proceed on the basis it cites, for two separate reasons.

**1. The cited contract belongs to a different customer.**
- The request is for BlueRiver Logistics (CRM-2051, ERP C-1002 Blue River Logistics LLC, DUNS 07-331-9025).
- Its justification is "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement."
- That agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and its Schedule B exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-15, up to 15% on NS-500) are between Northstar and Acme Mfg. Holdings (C-1001 / CRM-2048).
- Nothing in the records gives BlueRiver a contract or pricing exception. The only BlueRiver document is its support terms (SUP-BRL-2025), which cover NS-CLOUD support only and say nothing about discounts.
- Special terms do not transfer between customers. The request is identical to Acme's DR-9001 apart from the account and the discount, which suggests it may have been copied or entered against the wrong account.

**2. Michael Torres has no discount authority under the policy in force.**
- Pricing Policy 2026 and Approval Authority Matrix APP-MATRIX-2026 apply on 2026-09-23.
- Under them, a 12% discount falls in the >10% to ≤20% band. That band requires the **Commercial Policy Lead, Dana Okafor**.
- The matrix gives no authority to the VP Sales role, and authority attaches to the role.
- Michael also submitted this request himself.
- Even if the request were re-based on standard pricing, it would still need Dana Okafor's approval, recorded in CRM.

**Outcome: REVIEW_REQUIRED.** The request needs commercial review to establish its real basis: either BlueRiver-specific terms, if any exist, or standard pricing. It then needs Commercial Policy Lead approval.

Separately, the records show Michael approving discounts above 10% in 2026, for example DR-7016 at 18% on 2026-01-25. Under the 2026 matrix, those approvals belonged to the Commercial Policy Lead and may be worth a look.

```json
{
  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9107", "customer": "BlueRiver Logistics (CRM-2051) / Blue River Logistics LLC (ERP C-1002)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 12.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "michael.torres@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "Cited Acme Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and exception EXC-ACME-NS500-15 apply only to Acme Mfg. Holdings (C-1001/CRM-2048); no contract or pricing exception exists for BlueRiver Logistics"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026 / APP-MATRIX-2026", "requestor_limit": null, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "Commercial Policy Lead", "approver": "Dana Okafor"},
  "evidence": [
    "structured/discount_requests.csv: DR-9107",
    "structured/crm_accounts.csv: CRM-2051 BlueRiver Logistics",
    "structured/customers.csv: C-1002 Blue River Logistics LLC (same DUNS 07-331-9025)",
    "documents/acme_master_supply_agreement.md (ACME-MFG-2025, parties Northstar and Acme Mfg. Holdings)",
    "documents/acme_pricing_exception.md (EXC-ACME-NS500-15, customer Acme Manufacturing only)",
    "documents/blueriver_support_terms.md (SUP-BRL-2025, support for NS-CLOUD only, no pricing terms)",
    "documents/pricing_policy_2026.md",
    "documents/approval_authority_matrix.md",
    "structured/employees.csv and documents/organization_chart.md: Michael Torres = VP Sales; Dana Okafor = Commercial Policy Lead"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": ["Any contract or pricing exception granting BlueRiver Logistics discount terms on NS-500"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Confirm the intended basis of DR-9107: the cited Acme agreement does not cover BlueRiver; either produce BlueRiver-specific terms or re-base the request on standard pricing", "who": "Michael Torres / Kelly Floyd (BlueRiver account owner)", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Any approval of a 12% discount must come from the Commercial Policy Lead (Dana Okafor) and be recorded in Northstar CRM; the requestor (VP Sales) may not approve it", "who": "Dana Okafor", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Review 2026 approvals of discounts above 10% made by the VP Sales (e.g. DR-7016), which fall in the Commercial Policy Lead band under APP-MATRIX-2026", "who": "Revenue Operations", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
